about.title: About GloTrade
about.intro: GloTrade is Africa's trusted online retail store — a direct e-commerce platform providing customers across Nigeria and the continent with secure, reliable, and authentic shopping experiences. The platform is owned and operated by GloTrade, and developed and maintained by NEXGEN TECH INNOVATIONS LIMITED.
about.story1: GloTrade was founded with a single, powerful belief: that African consumers deserve access to high-quality, authentic products through a seamless and secure digital shopping experience.
about.story2: We built GloTrade as a direct retail platform to ensure total quality control, fast order fulfillment, and dedicated customer support from checkout to delivery.
about.story3: Today, GloTrade provides direct retail and reliable shipping across electronics, fashion, home essentials, and lifestyle goods to customers nationwide.
about.missionText: To empower African businesses and consumers with a secure, accessible, and innovative e-commerce platform that drives economic growth across the continent.
about.visionText: To be Africa's most trusted online retail store — a platform where customers shop with absolute confidence in quality, pricing, and fast delivery.
about.value1Desc: Every transaction on GloTrade is protected. We verify sellers, secure payments, and stand behind every purchase with our buyer protection guarantee.
about.value2Desc: Built in Africa, for Africa. We understand the unique needs of African buyers and sellers, and we design our platform around those realities.
about.value3Desc: We believe in empowering local entrepreneurs and connecting communities through commerce. Every seller on GloTrade is building a legacy.
about.value4Desc: From our GDIP insurance programme to our multilingual platform, we continuously innovate to solve real problems for our users.
about.value5Desc: No hidden fees, no surprises. We maintain clear pricing, honest policies, and open communication with both buyers and sellers.
about.value6Desc: We grow when our users grow. Our tools, resources, and support are designed to help every seller on our platform succeed and scale.
about.gdipDesc: The GDIP is GloTrade's flagship seller verification and insurance programme. GDIP-certified sellers meet GloTrade's highest standards of product quality and business integrity. When you buy from a GDIP partner, your purchase is backed by an additional layer of protection and service guarantee.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At GloTrade (with technical infrastructure developed and maintained by NEXGEN TECH INNOVATIONS LIMITED), your privacy matters. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal data in compliance with the Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR) and applicable laws.
privacyPolicy.sec1Txt1: When you register or make a purchase, we collect your full name, email address, phone number, delivery address, and payment details (processed securely by our certified payment providers).
privacyPolicy.sec1Txt2: We automatically collect information about how you interact with our platform — pages visited, products viewed, search queries, device info, IP address, browser type, and timestamps.
privacyPolicy.sec1Txt3: We maintain records of purchases, sales, returns, and other transactions to provide our services and comply with legal obligations.
privacyPolicy.sec2Txt1: To process your orders, facilitate payments, arrange delivery, and provide customer support.
privacyPolicy.sec2Txt2: To create and maintain your GloTrade account, verify your identity, and ensure account security.
privacyPolicy.sec2Txt3: To send order confirmations, shipping updates, promotional offers (where opted in), and important service announcements.
privacyPolicy.sec2Txt4: To analyze usage patterns, conduct research, fix bugs, and enhance the overall platform experience.
privacyPolicy.sec3Txt1: Your payment information is securely shared with our certified payment partners. We do not store your card details on our servers.
privacyPolicy.sec3Txt2: Your delivery address and contact information are shared with our shipping partners solely for order fulfilment.
privacyPolicy.sec3Txt3: We may disclose your information when required by law, court order, or regulatory authority, or to protect the rights and safety of GloTrade and its users.
privacyPolicy.sec3Txt4: We do NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for their own marketing purposes.
privacyPolicy.sec4Txt1: All data transmitted between your device and our servers is encrypted using TLS (Transport Layer Security) protocols.
privacyPolicy.sec4Txt2: Access to personal data is strictly limited to authorised GloTrade staff and partners who need it to perform their duties.
privacyPolicy.sec4Txt3: We conduct regular security assessments to identify and address potential vulnerabilities in our systems.
privacyPolicy.sec5Txt1: You may request a copy of the personal information we hold about you at any time.
privacyPolicy.sec5Txt2: You can update or correct your personal information through your account settings or by contacting our support team.
privacyPolicy.sec5Txt3: You may request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal obligations that require us to retain specific records.
privacyPolicy.sec5Txt4: You can opt out of marketing communications at any time via the unsubscribe link in any email or by contacting us directly.
privacyPolicy.sec6Txt1: Required for the platform to function correctly — keeping you logged in, maintaining your cart, and remembering your preferences.
privacyPolicy.sec6Txt2: Help us understand how visitors interact with our site so we can improve performance and usability.
privacyPolicy.sec6Txt3: You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality.
privacyPolicy.sec7Txt: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
privacyPolicy.sec8Txt: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us:

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of GloTrade. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these terms. Please read them carefully before proceeding.
termsOfService.warningText: By creating an account or using any GloTrade service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our platform.
termsOfService.sec1Txt1: GloTrade (glotrade.online) is a direct e-commerce online retail platform. The platform infrastructure is built and maintained by technical partner NEXGEN TECH INNOVATIONS LIMITED.
termsOfService.sec1Txt2: GloTrade is the direct seller of record for all products sold on glotrade.online. We directly oversee product sourcing, inventory quality, payment processing, and fulfillment.
termsOfService.sec2Txt1: You must be at least 18 years of age to create an account and use GloTrade. By registering, you confirm that you meet this requirement.
termsOfService.sec2Txt2: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Notify us immediately at support@glotrade.online if you suspect unauthorised access.
termsOfService.sec2Txt3: You may not create more than one personal account. Business and seller accounts are subject to additional verification requirements.
termsOfService.sec3Txt1: When you place an order, you are making a binding offer to purchase at the stated price. An order is only confirmed once you receive an official order confirmation from GloTrade.
termsOfService.sec3Txt2: Prices are displayed in Nigerian Naira (NGN) unless otherwise stated. All prices include applicable taxes where required by law. Shipping fees are additional and displayed at checkout.
termsOfService.sec3Txt3: GloTrade reserves the right to cancel any order in the event of pricing errors, out-of-stock situations, payment failures, or suspected fraudulent activity.
termsOfService.sec4Txt1: We make every effort to display accurate product descriptions, specifications, pricing, and availability. In the event of an inadvertent error, we reserve the right to correct pricing and cancel affected unfulfilled orders.
termsOfService.sec4Txt2: All products listed and sold on GloTrade are 100% genuine, authentic, and sourced directly from certified manufacturers and authorized distributors.
termsOfService.sec4Txt3: All orders are subject to stock availability. If an item becomes unavailable after an order is placed, we will notify you promptly and issue a full refund.
termsOfService.sec4Txt4: GloTrade handles all order processing, packaging, and logistics through our verified delivery network to ensure your orders arrive safely.
termsOfService.sec5Txt1: GloTrade uses third-party payment processors to handle all financial transactions. By making a payment, you also agree to the terms and privacy policies of our payment partners.
termsOfService.sec5Txt2: GloTrade does not store your full card details. All payment data is encrypted and processed in accordance with PCI DSS standards.
termsOfService.sec5Txt3: Seller payouts are processed after a confirmation period to allow for dispute resolution. GloTrade reserves the right to withhold payouts pending investigation of any disputed transaction.
termsOfService.prohibited1: Use GloTrade for any unlawful purpose or in violation of any regulation
termsOfService.prohibited2: Engage in fraudulent transactions, chargeback abuse, or payment manipulation
termsOfService.prohibited3: Harass, threaten, or abuse other users or GloTrade staff
termsOfService.prohibited4: Post false, misleading, or defamatory reviews or content
termsOfService.prohibited5: Attempt to circumvent or undermine platform security
termsOfService.prohibited6: Scrape or extract data from the platform without permission
termsOfService.prohibited7: Conduct transactions off-platform to avoid fees (fee circumvention)
termsOfService.prohibited8: Impersonate GloTrade or any other person or entity
termsOfService.sec6Txt1: Violation of these rules may result in immediate account suspension or termination, and may be reported to relevant Nigerian authorities.
termsOfService.sec7Txt1: All platform technology, software, and systems developed by NEXGEN TECH INNOVATIONS LIMITED for GloTrade, along with GloTrade branding and content, are protected by applicable intellectual property laws.
termsOfService.sec7Txt2: By uploading content (product images, descriptions, etc.) to GloTrade, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to display and use that content for platform-related purposes.
termsOfService.sec8Txt1: GloTrade stands behind the authenticity and quality of products sold on our platform, subject to standard manufacturer warranties and our comprehensive return policy.
termsOfService.sec8Txt2: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, GloTrade's total liability to you for any claim shall not exceed the total amount you paid to GloTrade in the 3 months preceding the claim.
termsOfService.sec8Txt3: GloTrade shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, even if we have been advised of the possibility of such damages.
termsOfService.sec9Txt1: In the event of any dispute between buyers and sellers, GloTrade will provide a mediation service. Both parties must attempt to resolve disputes through our platform's dispute resolution process before seeking external remedies.
termsOfService.sec9Txt2: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Any legal proceedings shall be conducted in the courts of Lagos State, Nigeria.
termsOfService.sec10Txt1: You may close your GloTrade account at any time by contacting our support team. Any pending transactions, payouts, or disputes will be resolved in accordance with our standard policies.
termsOfService.sec10Txt2: GloTrade reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or engage in activities harmful to the platform or its users.
termsOfService.sec10Txt3: GloTrade may modify these Terms at any time. We will provide notice of significant changes by posting the updated Terms with a new effective date. Continued use after changes constitutes your acceptance.

refundPolicy.title: Refund & Return Policy
refundPolicy.intro: We want you to be completely satisfied with every purchase on GloTrade. If something isn't right, we're here to make it right. This policy applies to all purchases made through glotrade.online.
refundPolicy.eligible1: Item received is significantly different from the product description
refundPolicy.eligible2: Item arrived damaged, defective, or broken
refundPolicy.eligible4: Item never arrived (confirmed by tracking as lost)
refundPolicy.eligible5: Item is missing parts or accessories as described
refundPolicy.notEligible1: Change of mind after the item has shipped
refundPolicy.notEligible2: Items explicitly marked as 'Final Sale' or 'Non-Returnable'
refundPolicy.notEligible5: Digital downloads or software once accessed
refundPolicy.notEligible6: Items damaged due to misuse by the buyer
refundPolicy.notEligible7: Items without original packaging where packaging is required
refundPolicy.notEligible8: Requests made after the return window has closed
refundPolicy.sec3Title: How to Request a Return or Refund
refundPolicy.step1Desc: Go to My Orders and locate the order you want to return.
refundPolicy.step2Desc: Select the reason and provide a brief description. Attach clear photos if the item is damaged or incorrect.
refundPolicy.step3Desc: Our team will review your request within 24–48 business hours and contact you with next steps.
refundPolicy.step4Desc: If approved, you'll receive return instructions. Pack the item securely and ship it back as instructed.
refundPolicy.step5Desc: Once the item is returned or the claim validated, your refund will be processed within 3–7 business days.
refundPolicy.tableNote: * Refund timelines may vary depending on your bank. GloTrade is not responsible for delays on the part of your financial institution.
refundPolicy.sec5Txt1: GloTrade covers the return shipping cost for all defective, damaged, or incorrectly delivered items. A prepaid return arrangement will be provided.
refundPolicy.sec5Txt2: For other eligible returns, return delivery to our fulfillment center can be arranged through our support team.
refundPolicy.sec5Txt3: Items must be returned in original condition with all packaging, tags, and accessories. GloTrade reserves the right to reject returns that do not meet these conditions.
refundPolicy.sec6Txt1: GloTrade does not currently offer direct item exchanges. Return the original item for a refund and place a new order for the desired item.
refundPolicy.sec6Txt2: You may cancel your order before it has been shipped by going to My Orders and selecting 'Cancel Order'. Full refunds are issued for successfully cancelled orders within 24–48 hours of confirmation.
refundPolicy.sellerWarningDesc: Because GloTrade is the direct retailer, our unified Refund & Return Policy applies equally to every product purchased on glotrade.online. No third-party seller exceptions.
refundPolicy.helpSubtitle: Our support team is here to assist you:

shippingPolicy.title: Shipping Policy
shippingPolicy.intro: GloTrade directly manages fulfillment and partners with leading logistics providers to dispatch orders safely and swiftly from our fulfillment centers in Lagos and Abuja across Nigeria and Africa.
shippingPolicy.sec1Txt1: Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days of payment confirmation. Business days are Monday–Friday, excluding Nigerian public holidays.
shippingPolicy.sec1Txt2: Orders placed after 2:00 PM WAT on business days, or on weekends and public holidays, will begin processing on the next business day.
shippingPolicy.sec1Txt3: You will receive a confirmation email with your real-time tracking details once your order has been dispatched from our fulfillment center.
shippingPolicy.sec1Txt4: Processing times may be longer during peak periods such as public holidays, promotional sales, and festive seasons.
shippingPolicy.domNote: * Delivery times are estimates calculated from dispatch date. Exact shipping fees are transparently displayed at checkout.
shippingPolicy.sec3Intro: GloTrade supports international shipping to select African and global destinations. International shipping availability and fees depend on the seller's capabilities and the destination country.
shippingPolicy.customsWarning: International shipments may be subject to customs duties, taxes, and import fees levied by the destination country. These charges are the responsibility of the buyer and are not included in the shipping fee.
shippingPolicy.track1: Once your order ships, you will receive an email with a tracking number and a link to monitor your delivery in real time.
shippingPolicy.track2: You can also track your orders directly from your GloTrade account under My Orders.
shippingPolicy.track3: If your tracking information hasn't updated in over 5 business days, please contact our support team for assistance.
shippingPolicy.sec5Txt1: If a delivery attempt fails because no one is available to receive the item, the logistics partner will typically make 2–3 attempts before returning the package to the seller.
shippingPolicy.sec5Txt2: GloTrade and sellers are not liable for delivery failures caused by an incorrect delivery address provided by the buyer. Please double-check your address before placing an order.
shippingPolicy.sec5Txt3: If your order is confirmed lost by the logistics partner, contact us immediately. We will investigate and initiate a refund or replacement where applicable. See our Refund Policy for details.
shippingPolicy.helpSubtitle: Our support team is available to help with any shipping or delivery issues:
